scope: Geometric/friction-cone preflight of prior design-only low shoe, not simulation, approved actuator, selected friction or a no-go theorem. A single convex contact at or below crest .060 touching a floor ball centeredY.175 gives these normal bounds. Ignores simultaneous contacts, finite-duration gravity, damping, spin/friction variation, changing contact state and other impulses. Friction.055 is an illustrative average of existing ball.06 and rail.05, not an implemented actuator material. Does not claim actual outgoing velocity.
